_doc: Gotham's rogues as the console has them tonight: who they are, where they are (locked up at Arkham or Blackgate, or at large), what they do, the crimes on the scanner that point to them and where they work. The scanner names a suspect when a crime is one of theirs and they're out.

rogues.name: The Joker
rogues.mo: Laughing gas, bombs, hostages, a punchline nobody else finds funny; out of Arkham more often than in.

rogues.name: Harley Quinn
rogues.mo: A former Arkham psychiatrist with a mallet and a crew; robbery, mayhem, and a soft spot she'd deny.

rogues.name: The Penguin
rogues.mo: A nightclub owner with a smuggling empire behind the bar; never holds the gun himself.

rogues.name: The Riddler
rogues.mo: Puzzles, deathtraps and a need to be the cleverest man in the room — he leaves a riddle so you know it.
kinds: Riddle left at a crime scene

rogues.name: Two-Face
rogues.mo: The former district attorney: every choice on the flip of a scarred coin, every job in twos.

rogues.name: Scarecrow
rogues.mo: Fear toxin in the air or the water supply; he studies what the terror does to you.

rogues.name: Poison Ivy
rogues.mo: Plants that strangle, pheromones that command; she'd tear the city down for the trees.

rogues.name: Mr. Freeze
rogues.mo: A cryogenicist in a refrigeration suit, stealing what keeps his wife alive; leaves people frozen.

rogues.name: Bane
rogues.mo: A strategist with a soldier's body and Venom in his veins; breaks prisons, cities and men.

rogues.name: Killer Croc
rogues.mo: A man gone reptile in the sewers under the docks; what's found of his victims is found in pieces.

rogues.name: Black Mask
rogues.mo: The False Face Society's boss behind a steel mill and a cosmetics firm; torture as management.

rogues.name: Mad Hatter
rogues.mo: Mind-control hats and an obsession with Alice; abducts young women who look the part.

rogues.name: Victor Zsasz
rogues.mo: A serial killer who carves a tally into his own skin for every life he takes.

rogues.name: Firefly
rogues.mo: A pyromaniac in a flight suit with a flamethrower; he likes to watch it burn.

rogues.name: Hush
rogues.mo: A surgeon wrapped in bandages, Bruce Wayne's childhood friend and his most patient enemy.

rogues.name: Clayface
rogues.mo: A failed actor made of mud who can be anyone; nobody ever saw who did it.

rogues.name: The Ventriloquist
rogues.mo: A meek man whose dummy, Scarface, runs a gang and gives the orders.

rogues.name: Professor Pyg
rogues.mo: A surgeon in a pig mask who 'perfects' his victims into mindless Dollotrons.

rogues.name: Calendar Man
rogues.mo: Crimes on holidays and anniversaries; talks in dates and waits for his day.

rogues.name: Deathstroke
rogues.mo: The world's most expensive mercenary; in Gotham only when someone's paid for a death.

rogues.name: Ra's al Ghul
rogues.mo: The Demon's Head, centuries old, the League of Assassins at his command; cleanses cities.

rogues.name: Hugo Strange
rogues.mo: A psychiatrist who has studied Batman for years and wants to become him.

rogues.name: Man-Bat
rogues.mo: A zoologist who turned himself into a bat-creature; mostly sighted, rarely caught.

rogues.name: Carmine Falcone
rogues.mo: The Roman: Gotham's old-money mob boss, with judges and police on his payroll.

rogues.name: Sal Maroni
rogues.mo: Falcone's rival, the man who threw acid in Harvey Dent's face.

rogues.name: Rupert Thorne
rogues.mo: A crime boss who owns councilmen; keeps his hands clean and his debts collected.

rogues.name: Killer Moth
rogues.mo: A costumed thief with a moth suit and a grudge, more nuisance than menace.

rogues.name: The Court of Owls
rogues.mo: A secret society older than the city's charter, with undying Talons to kill for it. Most say it's a nursery rhyme.
